hypothesis: In-sample mean patient residual norms were0.007-0.011 and corrections changed no decisions. Obtain honest residual targets from patient-held-out MLP predictions inside each existing source fitting partition, then learn corrections in the unchanged full-source embedding.
outer_policy: Original validation and original3outer patient folds only; never use source stopping or outer patients in any residual teacher fit/target.
crossfit_source_policy: For each of4source partitions and3source seeds, fit3new MLPs on patient-disjoint2/3teacher-fitting partitions, with a further20%inner stopping split. Teacher architecture/configuration and seed match its M5 source; the heldout third supplies residual probabilities only. Each actual fitting patient receives exactly one honest prediction.
support: Patient/coarse-label means in the unchanged full-source MLP embedding; class masses1/3. Source and query probabilities remain from full source. Only residual training targets use crossfit probabilities.
teacher_limit: Crossfit teachers see fewer patients than the full source, so residuals also include training-size/model variation; this is an experimental control, not an unbiased estimate of the full-source generalization error.
selection: All arms get all original folds. Only crossfit residual candidates with higher originalCV than M5 and validation Macro-F1 no lower than M5 can qualify; strongest would require new fixed patient partitions against both prior development references.
external_test_policy: No external scoring, predictions or raw images; no parameter search using external outcomes.
